title: Contract-supplied display string is stored as text without a validity check (fictional example)
severity_basis: Fictional example of an embargoed record. Worst plausible case, not verified: a contract-supplied string with bytes the database rejects makes the write fail and ingestion stop.

entries.expected: contract-supplied bytes are validated, or stored as bytes, before reaching a text column
entries.observed: an ScString is passed through to a text parameter unchanged

embargo.policy: none in repository (the example project has no SECURITY.md)
embargo.lift_condition: Either the halt is shown not to be reachable (the record becomes public, low or not-a-defect), or it is reported and fixed, or 90 days pass from the report
withheld: the XDR103 suppression for this site in the project's suppression list
the report row for this site in the linter report
any corpus entry built to trigger it
